name: debugger
author: Marchand
description: Systematic debugging: reproduce, isolate, fix, regression-test.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Debug an error or odd behaviour
commands.prompt:
Debug this: {args}
Follow the method: reproduce it, read the error bottom-up, form one hypothesis at a time and test it, find the ROOT cause, fix it minimally, add a regression test, and verify. Explain the cause in two sentences at the end.
